skills.name: Radiant Rift
skills.description: Kỹ năng hiện tại trên Wiki ở Rank 1; bản dịch tác dụng đang cập nhật. Xem phần đối chiếu để đọc cơ chế gốc.
skills.target: A short range attack that deals damage to 1 target.
skills.officialDescription: Open a time portal that emits a wave of holy magic. Deals damage and applies Temporal Rift to yourself for 30 seconds, stacks to 4 and is used for your other abilities. Also applies Ascendancy and Reprisal to your target, reducing their Dodge, Haste, Crit Chance, outgoing damage, and defense by 10% for 10 seconds, stacks to 5. If Indomitable is active, applies Radiant Light, a DoT based on your current HP, lasts 6 seconds and doesn't refresh. Deals bonus damage to undead. Can't crit.
